+"""Replayable retrieve_cube trajectory for the frozen /app/instance.json scene."""
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def tilted_y(quat_wxyz, angle_degrees):
+    base = Rotation.from_quat([quat_wxyz[1], quat_wxyz[2], quat_wxyz[3], quat_wxyz[0]])
+    q = (Rotation.from_euler("y", angle_degrees, degrees=True) * base).as_quat()
+    return np.array([q[3], q[0], q[1], q[2]])
+
+
+def generate(s):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+    s.record_start()
+    vertical = p["top_down_quat"](1.57)
+
+    # Clamp the upright container around its narrow side, then lift it.
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.44, 0.073, 1.0], vertical, linear=5, max_dq=0.03)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.44, 0.073, 0.865], vertical, linear=7, max_dq=0.015)
+    p["close_gripper"]("right", 20)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.44, 0.073, 1.05], vertical, linear=6, max_dq=0.015)
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.48, 0.14, 1.05], vertical, linear=5, max_dq=0.015)
+
+    # A ten-step wrist motion ejects the cube onto the target. Let it land.
+    turned = tilted_y(vertical, -120)
+    q7, _, _ = s.ik("right", [0.48, 0.14, 1.05], turned)
+    start = s.hold_action()
+    end = start.copy()
+    end[:7] = q7
+    for step in range(1, 11):
+        s.step(start + (end - start) * (step / 10))
+    p["hold"](90)
+
+    # The container remains held above the table. Move its footprint away.
+    p["move_ee"]("right", [0.62, 0.14, 1.05], turned,
+                 linear=5, max_dq=0.015, tol=0.015)
+    p["hold"](60)
+
+    live_status = s.status()
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, {"method": "grip, eject, move container aside"})
+    print("saved", OUT, "actions", len(actions), "live", live_status, flush=True)
+    assert live_status["success"], "Generated trajectory did not succeed"
+
+    for replay_index in (1, 2):
+        replay_status = s.replay(actions)
+        print("replay", replay_index, replay_status, flush=True)
+        assert replay_status["success"], f"Replay {replay_index} failed"
+    return actions
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    generate(Session("retrieve_cube", instance="/app/instance.json"))
*** End Patch"))
